text: Implemented pure-R v3 reference estimator with explicit M/Gamma, dominated marginals, symmetric Jensen-Shannon selection costs, edge-normalized chronology, smoothing excluded from scientific energy, Beta(2,2) quadrature, zero-M boundary, and separate diagnostics. Focused objective/gradient/selection/split tests pass; actual 12-vs-24 pair energy difference 2.57e-5 and candidate information threshold passes.
